This '''shop''', located at [[Kal'Shebbol starport]], was run by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Loh'khar]] the Finder. The shop had been established after the Twi'lek had his ship impounded by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]'s forces, effectively stranding him on the planet.
